note: v56.98 — Codex structural review step 1: AI entity identity confirmed through the screen registry, portfolio risk weights in one base currency, event dedupe / earnings retry / HTTP status / mount cleanup, return-contract dates and horizons (P1406-P1409).

p.title: Event dedupe keeps the next genuine update; earnings retry; HTTP status kept; news mount cleanup
p.symptom: Codex structural review: document original → window mirror → document update (same detail, < 250ms) delivered once instead of twice; the briefing earnings request set a global flag before the call and never cleared it, so one failure blocked retries for the tab and a late response re-rendered after leaving; a 503 HTML body became status 0 / HTTP_FAILED; a news mount that threw left its bridge DOM.
p.root_cause: The adapter remembered suppressed mirrors (rewriting the record source); the flag had no failure path; response.json() failure fell into the transport catch; the page bag was never disposed on a throwing mount.
p.fix: bootstrap.js remembers only delivered events; briefing-read.js clears the request flag in finally, retries after 60s, re-renders a late response only while the briefing is open; http.js keeps the status and reports HTTP_PARSE_FAILED for an unparseable 2xx body; news.js disposes its bag when the first render throws.
p.violated_rule: Lifecycle: a failure path restores retry; a transport error keeps its cause.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check P1408 (adapter sequence, HTTP 503 HTML and bad-body cases).
